audit.current_question:
Find the value of the variable y in the trapezoid (the expression (3x − 70)° denotes the upper-right interior angle).
Choices:
A:10
B:20
C:30
D:70
audit.adaptation_reason: The source incorrectly calls a non-right trapezoid right and places the (3x−70) label outside despite the intended interior-angle calculation. Clarified and bound that expression to the interior angle, retaining shape, expressions, and target.
audit.independent_solution: The parallel sides give x+120=180, so x=60. The upper-right interior angle is3x−70=110; its supplement is3y+40=70, hence y=10.

visual_review.method: Every source and every final redraw was visually inspected in labeled per-item review sheets; crowded cases were additionally inspected full-size. This is not user Pass.
